purpose: Test a new whole-window safe-coordination mechanism that can improve paper social welfare without accepting a complete assignment whose frozen FaaSRank sequential score is worse than the untouched faithful FaaSRank initializer.

diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.root_cause: The V79/V80 guard compares one player's mutable-state score before each move. Earlier moves alter node aggregates and therefore the score landscape for later players. No immutable complete FaaSRank assignment, complete-assignment certificate, or atomic fallback exists. Pointwise local nonworsening therefore does not imply whole-window nonworsening.

scientific_boundary.E510_E529_disposition: permanently_unused_after_V80_screen_failure; reserved confirmation inputs were never generated

candidate.initializer: exact frozen FaaSRank native request/DAG order, deterministic epsilon-greedy decision, rolling diversity history and complete feasible assignment
candidate.proposal: paper-utility best-response and price-feedback coordination from the immutable initializer; every move must strictly improve the moving player's paper utility, but no Hiku/Jiagu/Orion/OCS outcome proxy is used
candidate.complete_assignment_faasrank_certificate: For each complete assignment, reset to the same pre-placement node aggregates and the same frozen pre-window FaaSRank history, traverse the same native player order, evaluate the frozen FaaSRank score for that assignment's selected node, add the player to the reconstructed state and rolling history, then accumulate scores in f64.
candidate.complete_assignment_welfare_certificate: Evaluate initializer and proposal social welfare under the same immutable baseline price signal and unchanged paper utility.
acceptance_rule: proposal complete-assignment paper social welfare exceeds initializer welfare by EPSILON
proposal complete-assignment frozen FaaSRank sequential score plus EPSILON is at least the initializer score
candidate.fallback_rule: If any acceptance predicate fails, atomically return the untouched initializer assignment and immutable baseline price signal; dispatch/history updates use only the accepted assignment.

implementation_tests_required_before_bui: registered profile round-trips through environment parsing and reports the exact guard name
whole-assignment FaaSRank certificate is deterministic and independent of HashMap insertion order
the faithful initializer certificate recomputes identically from its saved complete assignment
a complete proposal with worse whole-window FaaSRank score is rejected even when its last local move was nonworse
a proposal with non-improved immutable-baseline welfare is rejected
a complete proposal satisfying both certificates is accepted
fallback restores the exact initializer assignment hash and baseline signal
offline reference construction and all previously registered profiles remain unchanged
execution_order: Commit this plan before modifying scheduler code or generating any E530-E559 artifact.
Implement only the single registered profile and required observability; do not change any baseline, paper utility, reference search, common HPA, workload, or environment parameter.
Pass all focused and full sche_nash tests, rustfmt and release build; freeze source commit and binary hash before input generation.
Generate only E530-E539 screen inputs, capture each base tape once, derive each scale5 tape once and bind identical per-seed tapes to all ten methods.
Build exactly ten state-matched candidate references, then run ninety baselines and ten candidate runs strictly serially without printing or opening intermediate QC or performance output.
Require 100 attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact ten-way pairing, one runtime identity and a complete result-free joint audit before simultaneous reveal.
If and only if the screen passes all three frozen arithmetic-mean gates, freeze the unchanged candidate and commit a formal-confirmation execution receipt before generating E540-E559 inputs.
If any screen gate fails, retain all artifacts, do not tune on E530-E539, generate no E540-E559 inputs and close this mechanism family.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across all ten E530-E539 seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput/(drained-cohort mean latency*cost) across finite positive-completion runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same per-run QPR with undefined or zero-completion runs assigned zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.baseline_threshold: Per metric, the largest arithmetic mean among the nine same-seed baselines.
analysis.screen_gate: The candidate must strictly exceed all three baseline thresholds; ties fail.
analysis.paired_uncertainty: Report candidate-minus-each-baseline paired BCa 95% intervals without changing the arithmetic-mean gate.
analysis.mechanism_diagnostics: Report guard evaluation/accept/fallback counts and certificate deltas only after the result-free joint audit; these cannot alter the frozen gate or candidate.
analysis.screen_success_action: Authorize preparation, but not success, of the untouched E540-E559 formal confirmation block.
analysis.screen_failure_action: Retain every artifact, do not tune on E530-E539, generate no confirmation inputs and close the window-safe family.
